journey.name: scan onchain no amount to amount
journey.description: Verifies that an on-chain BIP21 request without an amount, or with a zero amount, still opens the Send Amount screen with an empty amount, so the user enters one before Confirm. Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with confirmed sats in Savings, funded through the lsp regtest deposit and mine (see ../README.md), and a regtest address the wallet does not own. Start on the wallet home screen. Nothing is broadcast.

actions.action: Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>" to.bitkit.dev
Verify the Send Amount screen (testTag "SendNumberField") is visible with an amount of 0
Enter 10000 with the number pad keys (testTags "N1", "N0") and tap Continue (testTag "ContinueAmount")
Verify the Confirm screen opens with the amount (testTag "ReviewAmount") showing 10 000
Tap Back (testTag "NavigationBack") and verify the Send Amount screen shows 10 000, then close the sheet without sending
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:<regtest address>?amount=0" to.bitkit.dev
Verify the Send Amount screen (testTag "SendNumberField") is visible with an amount of 0, then close the sheet without sending
